# Cohosting city release — 10 October 2026

Primary competitor pages consulted:

- [Azure, Marrakech](https://www.azureconciergerie.com/en/pricing): management from 20%, with separate wording about platform fees. A starting rate is different from the fixed 20% requested for COOHOSTY.
- [CasaConciergerie, Casablanca](https://casaconciergerie.com/faq): 20% of net receipts after platform fees, cleaning charged to the guest and tourist tax.
- [Léman, Tanger](https://www.leman-immobilier.com/): 20% per booking; cleaning paid by the guest.

These offers show that an identical headline percentage can use different calculation bases. COOHOSTY presents the user-authorized fixed 20% per booking. The quote specifies platform fees, cleaning, taxes and additional expenses because the user has not yet selected a net/gross basis. The interactive example labels the 80% remainder as a balance before other costs, not net profit. Applying 20% to each booking equals applying 20% to the total when the same basis is used.

Clipnova.com was requested as inspiration, but web and browser access failed from this environment. The implementation builds on COOHOSTY's established Inter font, orange/black/white palette, rounded cards and restrained motion. No competitor content, images, revenue claims, discounts or tax-inclusive pricing were copied.

Implemented three dedicated service pages in French, English and Arabic, reciprocal language/canonical metadata, sitemap discovery, homepage/service/footer links, shared 12-service COHOST listing, distinct city copy, progressive commission animation, accessible simulator and city-aware estimate continuation. Existing Marrakech neighbourhood map and guides are retained.

Local checks: build, TypeScript and lint passed; 108 unit tests passed, one database test skipped. Browser suite: 22 passed, two sender-dependent tests skipped. Desktop/mobile screenshots cover all three cities. Final palette refinement is rechecked before deployment.
